content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble setting up communication between the [product_name] and my PC via Ethernet. The IP addresses are not matching, and when I attempt to detect the IP of 8 [product_name] devices, [product_name] software doesn't show them. When I try to transfer data from the device to my PC, I receive an error. Can you provide guidance on how to configure the PC in [product_name] software for establishing a connection? For reference, here are the addresses I used: [product_name] ([article_no]): IP 192.168.101.203, Mask 255.255.255.000; PC: IP 192.168.101.202, Mask 255.255.255.000; [product_name] software ([version_no]): IP 192.168.101.203, Mask 255.255.255.000. Thanks in advance for your support and swift replies.
With [product_name] software [version_no], you can program or manage any [article_no] module. However, to work with certain modules, you may need the newer [product_name] software [version_no].
Thanks, I'll look for the [product_name] software [version_no] and give it another attempt.
It's resolved, I managed to create a direct connection between the device and my PC. However, I'm not sure how to enable the web server feature in the [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users initially faced difficulties connecting their [product_name] hardware ([article_no]) to a PC through Ethernet, due to incompatibility issues with [product_name] software [version_no]. These connection challenges were resolved by switching to a newer version of the software that supports the specific hardware. However, users encountered limitations with the demo version, which doesn't allow activation of the web server feature. Restricted access to important functions in the demo version was identified as a significant frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate simple and reliable Ethernet connectivity between their hardware and PC, along with full access to features such as the web server, irrespective of which software version or license they use.
